title: Sketch a ring: draw a stroke on screen, project it onto the surface as the ring's anchors
description: User idea 2026-10-08: drag a stroke across the view (like an SVG path) and project it onto the visible surface to seed a ring's authored anchors, instead of clicking anchors one by one. The stroke covers the visible side; the ring closes round the far side by the usual tracing (or the crease mode, CRAW crease-following rings). Needs screen-to-surface picking along the stroke (shares the pick math with the TOOL pick/project ticket).
definition-of-done: 1. A sketch gesture in the ring tool turns a dragged stroke into a draft ring whose anchors follow the stroke on the visible surface and close round the back. 2. Resample the stroke to a sensible anchor count. 3. Undoable, saved like any ring.
testing-plan: Headless drag route over a procedural tube; live on the crawfish.
